headline: Strong 2Q; margin pressure led earnings cut

highlights: Refer to Important Disclosures at the end of this report BUY Eureka Forbes Strong 2Q; margin pressure led earnings cut Consumer Durables  Result Update  November 04, 2026 CMP (Rs): 342 | TP (Rs): 450 Eureka Forbes delivered strong 2Q results, with revenue growing 15% yoy to Rs8.9bn (~4% above our estimate), driven by broad-based growth across channels and categories.
Operating leverage supported profitability, with EBITDAM at 12.9% (~90bps above our estimate), despite gross margin (GM) contraction due to commodity cost pressures.
Management expects growth to accelerate in 2HFY27 (1H growth: 15.1%), with strong momentum visible through the ongoing festive period.
Water purifier revenue grew in high-teens, alongside market share gains.
valuation: Also, we lower our valuation multiple to 30x from 45x earlier, largely factoring in the persistent commodity pressures, competitive intensity, and limited visibility on sustained volume-led growth.
